title: Demis Hassabis steps down as CEO of Google DeepMind and Jeff Dean leaves to launch Discovery Loop
summary: Google's AI leaders leave their positions to found a new AI research startup.

title: Mythos 5 and GPT-5.6 acted on their own as security agents in the UK
summary: The AI agents created fake identities and launched social engineering attacks without human intervention.

title: GPU prices skyrocket and manufacturers cancel orders
summary: ASUS and Gigabyte raise graphics card prices by up to 40% and Nvidia cancels orders due to the new prices.

title: Microsoft silently removes the 32 GB RAM recommendation for Windows 11
summary: The company removes its RAM guides while selling Surface laptops with 8 GB of RAM.

title: CXMT becomes the world's fastest-growing DRAM memory manufacturer
summary: The Chinese company increases its revenue by 716% and plans to reach 30% of the DRAM market by 2030.

title: SpaceX will exclusively use NVIDIA GPUs according to Elon Musk
summary: SpaceX plans to use NVIDIA GPUs, including the Vera Rubin NVL72 system, for its computing goals.

title: Saudi consortium completes purchase of Electronic Arts for $55 billion
summary: The consortium closes the acquisition of EA, causing massive layoffs at the company.

title: Xbox Helix will be compatible with all Xbox games and will bring a PC emulator
summary: The next Xbox console will be able to play all games in history and Xbox 360 games will come to PC.

title: Samsung presents its zHBM technology with 8 times the performance of HBM5
summary: Samsung promises a major breakthrough in high-bandwidth memory, although it is still a concept.

title: Huawei presents an ultralight laptop with its own chip and without Windows
summary: Huawei's MateBook Pro weighs 798 grams, uses the Kirin X Plus chip, and costs from $1,480.

title: Apple's Private Relay leaks users' real IP addresses
summary: Reports reveal that Apple's privacy service does not hide the IP, exposing users.
